## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks: raw records

Run 6 is the D≈0 electron point at n=+3.2×10¹² cm⁻², swept 0→10 T; run 7 is the hole point at n=−1.2×10¹² cm⁻², swept 10→0.3 T. The trace below uses each run's recorded current channel and gain, and is plotted before background removal or FFT. Both sweeps completed with gate currents below 0.3 nA and without voltage clipping (50 µV SR1 full scale). Run 5 supplies the region-A gate calibration; only B1–B2 is wired as Rxx.

from hera.analysis import open_run, resolve_channels, current_channel, summarize_run
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(9, 7), sharex=True)
for j, rid in enumerate((6, 7)):
    r = open_run(f"data/{rid}")
    print(summarize_run(r))
    cc = current_channel(resolve_channels(r.meta))
    I = r.col(cc.col) / cc.gain
    B = r.col("magnet_field")
    R = r.col("sr1_X") / I
    ix = np.argsort(B)
    ax[j].plot(B[ix], R[ix], lw=0.8)
    ax[j].set(ylabel="Rxx B1-B2 (Ω)", title=f"run {rid} raw, D≈0; {'electron' if rid == 6 else 'hole'} side")
    print(f"run {rid}: I median {np.median(I)*1e9:.2f} nA; R range {np.min(R):.0f} to {np.max(R):.0f} Ω; T {np.min(r.col('T_sample')):.3f}–{np.max(r.col('T_sample')):.3f} K; max |I_gate| {max(np.max(np.abs(r.col('k_2400_tg_curr'))),np.max(np.abs(r.col('k_2400_bg_curr'))))*1e12:.0f} pA")
ax[-1].set_xlabel("B (T)")
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()

## Runs 6–7 — frequency content and fan choice

The windowed FFT shows an electron-side high-field tone near 30 T at n=+3.2×10¹², close to F_L=33.1 T, together with peaks near 7, 15, and 22 T. The latter approximate a harmonic series, so a single-density peak list cannot establish their pocket origin; the near-F_L tone may itself be a sum/breakdown or harmonic. On the hole side (n=−1.2×10¹²), broad content near 5–7 and 12 T is less discriminating because the model's near-CNP ABAB tones overlap and ABCA is thermally heavy. `sdh_onset` tracks the electron ~30 T component from about 1.8 T; its lower global onset is censored by low-frequency/residual content, so the fan starts at 1.2 T to retain the low-field record and test the candidate light branch. **Verdict:** the electron side advances to a D≈0 fan; neither spot check alone justifies a stacking call. The next read must test frequency trajectories, harmonics and the Luttinger sum, including the possible second ridge/domain in run 5.

from hera.analysis import open_run, resolve_channels, current_channel, sdh_fft, sdh_onset
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(9, 7), sharex=True)
for j, rid in enumerate((6, 7)):
    r = open_run(f"data/{rid}")
    cc = current_channel(resolve_channels(r.meta))
    I = r.col(cc.col) / cc.gain
    B, R = r.col("magnet_field"), r.col("sr1_X") / I
    for blo in (1.2, 1.5, 2.0):
        f, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(blo, 10.0), nfft=4096, log=False)
        y = spec[0]
        ax[j].plot(f, y / np.max(y), label=f"{blo}–10 T")
        peaks, _ = find_peaks(y, prominence=0.12 * np.max(y))
        print(f"run {rid}, B≥{blo}: "+", ".join(f"{f[k]:.1f} T" for k in sorted(peaks,key=lambda k:y[k],reverse=True)[:6]))
    o = sdh_onset(R, B, b_lo=0.8, r_full_scale=5000)
    print(f"run {rid}: {o.summary()}")
    ax[j].set(xlim=(0, 45), ylabel="FFT / max", title=f"run {rid} window test")
    ax[j].legend()
ax[-1].set_xlabel("frequency (T)")
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: D≈0 electron Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`)

> **05:25** · landau-fan-vti: region A, D=0, n +3.2 to +1.8e12 (31), B 1.2 to 10 T (74 uniform 1/B), SR1 50 uV, 3 s fast dwell; ends B=10 T, gates 0 V · **ETA ~09:05** (≈3h40m)

Runs 6–7 put the useful field-dependent content on the electron side: run 6 at n=+3.2×10¹² has a ~30 T high-field feature and ~7/15/22 T peaks whose harmonic relationship prevents a one-point stacking call; run 7 is near the hole-side CNP and its tones overlap. This fan follows `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count` Step 4, using run-5 region-A calibration at D=0 and the run-6 settling and 50 µV sensitivity. It scans n=+1.8→+3.2×10¹² cm⁻²; the hole side is excluded because the D=0 gate line reaches only −1.27×10¹² inside the validators and the −1.2 spot is model-exception/thermal-limited. A full two-side fan would cost a second multi-hour traverse yet not supply a high-|n| hole discriminator.

**Computed feasibility.** The forward model at n=+1.8 gives ABAB (2.94, 15.67) T versus ABCA 18.61 T; at +3.2 it gives (7.31, 25.78) T versus 33.08 T. The electron ~30 T spot feature is not an unambiguous ABCA pocket: a fourth harmonic of ~7.5 T or a breakdown/sum orbit can land there. The 1.2→10 T record gives δF=1.36 T; the ABAB-heavy/ABCA split is 2.94 T at the low-density edge (just above 2δF) and 7.31 T at the high edge. The ABAB light branch has ~5.4 periods only at the high-density end; absence at low n will carry no weight. Uniform-1/B grid: **74 B rows** at Δ(1/B)=0.01005 T⁻¹, meeting 3 samples per F_L=33.08 T period. **31 density points** at Δn=0.0467×10¹², giving 2.49 samples per fourfold LL ray at B=1.2 T. Run-5 Rxx at n=1.8 is ~383 Ω at 0 T; scaling by run-6's ~3.7× MR gives ~1.4 kΩ for the worst corner, below 5 kΩ full scale with ~3.5× headroom. Stop at the first rows if that estimate fails.

**Price and checkpoints.** 2,294 points × (3.0 s fast dwell + ~0.2 s read/set overhead from run 5) ≈ 2 h 02 m; 8.8 T magnet traverse at 0.137 T/min ≈ 64 m, plus 0→1.2 T positioning ≈ 9 m, row overhead and margin → **3 h 40 m**. The fast dwell is 10τ for SR1 at τ=0.3 s / 24 dB, preserving FFT amplitudes across the paired gate line. First 2–3 rows: inspect all channels, gate currents, temperature freshness, clipping and gate trajectory; abort on sustained >1 nA leakage, rails, wrong state or a dead channel. Then check landed rows near 3, 6 and 8 T, with partial raw maps and frequency tracks where the 1/B span permits; continue only while the record can distinguish branch trajectories. The cell parks TG/BG at 0 after completion and leaves B at 10 T for a possible measured ride-down.

# === Tetralayer FS-count electron fan: run-5 region-A calibration, D = 0 ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
from hera.analysis import field_invB

# Preconditions: inherited state only. The cell sets its own sensitivity, gates, and B.
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _Tv0, _B0 = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field()
_Vtg0, _Vbg0, _Vsi0 = k_tg.volt(), k_bg.volt(), k_si()
_amp, _tau, _slope = sr1.amplitude(), sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope()
print(f"preconditions: T_sample={_T0:.3f} K (1.0..1.5), T_vaporizer={_Tv0:.3f} K (<1.5); B={_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05); "
      f"TG/BG/Si=({_Vtg0:+.4f},{_Vbg0:+.4f},{_Vsi0:+.4f}) V (all 0); PS={magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output={magnet.output_enabled()}; "
      f"drive={_amp:.3f} V (1.0), SR1 tau={_tau:.3f} s (0.3), slope={_slope} dB/oct (24)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and 0.5 <= _Tv0 <= 1.5
assert abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(_Vtg0) < 0.01 and abs(_Vbg0) < 0.01 and abs(_Vsi0) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert abs(_amp - 1.0) < 0.01 and abs(_tau - 0.3) < 0.01 and _slope == 24
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1

CAL_FAN = dict(c_tg=2.7960593093052633e-3, c_bg=2.160696465377614e-3,
               n_offset=-0.08937933224099137, D_offset=-0.013)
N_FAST, N_B = 31, 74
ns_fan = np.linspace(3.2, 1.8, N_FAST)  # high n first; low n is the worst high-B corner
Ds_fan = np.zeros(N_FAST)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns_fan, Ds_fan, **CAL_FAN)
B_vec = field_invB(1.2, 10.0, N_B)
assert np.all(np.isfinite(Vtgs)) and np.all(np.isfinite(Vbgs))
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX
assert np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0) and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
_ncheck, _Dcheck = calc_nD(Vtgs, Vbgs, **CAL_FAN)
assert np.max(np.abs(_ncheck - ns_fan)) < 1e-5 and np.max(np.abs(_Dcheck)) < 1e-5
print(f"grid: {N_B} B rows {B_vec[0]:.3f}->{B_vec[-1]:.3f} T, d(1/B)={abs(1/B_vec[1]-1/B_vec[0]):.5f} T^-1; "
      f"{N_FAST} n points {ns_fan[0]:+.3f}->{ns_fan[-1]:+.3f}e12, dn={abs(ns_fan[1]-ns_fan[0]):.4f}e12; "
      f"TG [{Vtgs.min():+.4f},{Vtgs.max():+.4f}] BG [{Vbgs.min():+.4f},{Vbgs.max():+.4f}] V")

sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)  # 5 kOhm at 10 nA; fixed through the fan
print(f"SR1 sensitivity={sr1.sensitivity():.2e} V (expect 50 uV)")
assert abs(sr1.sensitivity() - 50e-6) < 1e-9

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = _Vsi0; mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = ("landau-fan-vti electron region A: run-5 cal, D=0; n +3.2 to +1.8e12 cm^-2 (31), "
                  "B 1.2 to 10 T (74 uniform 1/B), Si=0, SR1=50uV, fast_delay=3s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment('region A B1-B2 Rxx; D=0 V/nm; n=+3.2..+1.8e12 cm^-2 (31); B=1.2..10.0 T (74 uniform 1/B); '
              'calibration run 5; spots runs 6-7; SR1 50uV, tau 0.3s/24dB, fast_delay 3s; Si 0V')

s.ramp(k_bg.volt, float(Vbgs[0])); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, float(Vtgs[0]))
interruptible_sleep(5)
magnet.field(float(B_vec[0]))  # blocking 0 -> 1.2 T, ~9 min; driver includes settle
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_Tstart, _Bstart = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"fan start: T_sample={_Tstart:.3f} K (1.0..1.5), B={_Bstart:.4f} T (1.2), TG/BG=({k_tg.volt():+.4f},{k_bg.volt():+.4f}) V")
assert 1.0 <= _Tstart <= 1.5 and abs(_Bstart - 1.2) < 0.03
assert abs(k_tg.volt() - Vtgs[0]) < 0.01 and abs(k_bg.volt() - Vbgs[0]) < 0.01

# Row layout: time, B, TG, BG, T_sample, I_TG, I_BG, sr0.X/P, sr1.X/P.
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot('time', T_sample)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)
s.plot('time', sr0.X); s.plot('time', sr0.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot('time', sr1.P)

I_TRIP = 1e-9
def fan_guard(station, data):
    temp, i_tg, i_bg = float(data[4]), abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if not (1.0 <= temp <= 1.5) or i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"FAN TRIP: B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, T={temp:.3f} K, |I_TG|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_BG|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(fan_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs],
                     slow_delay=1.0, fast_delay=3.0)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0.0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0.0)
print(f"fan ended: B={magnet.field():+.4f} T, TG={k_tg.volt():+.4f} V, BG={k_bg.volt():+.4f} V")
